vocabulary.meaning_en: rules and actions that protect people from injury at work
vocabulary.example: Health and safety is important in every workplace.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something bad that happens by chance and causes injury or damage
vocabulary.example: There was an accident in the office today.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to fall over
vocabulary.example: Tom took a tumble while chasing a mouse.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to hit your foot on something and fall
vocabulary.example: He tripped over a box on the floor.

vocabulary.meaning_en: harm done to a person's body
vocabulary.example: Were there any injuries?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to injure a joint by twisting it
vocabulary.note_en: A sprain is less serious than a break.
vocabulary.example: He sprained his wrist.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person at work trained to give basic medical help
vocabulary.example: Call the first-aider, please.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to write information in the spaces on a form
vocabulary.example: You have to fill in an accident report form.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an official form to record what happened in an accident
vocabulary.note_en: Also called an incident report form.
vocabulary.example: The accident report form is on the intranet.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the official way of doing something
vocabulary.example: It's procedure and it's the law.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the rules of a country
vocabulary.example: Reporting accidents at work is the law.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the place where people work
vocabulary.example: The workplace must be safe.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a private computer network inside a company
vocabulary.example: You'll find the form on the company intranet.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the thing that makes something happen
vocabulary.example: What was the cause of the accident?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stop something from happening
vocabulary.example: How could the accident have been avoided?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put things away in a place to keep them
vocabulary.example: Store boxes in the cupboard, not on the floor.

vocabulary.meaning_en: neat and in order
vocabulary.example: Keep the office tidy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put things in their correct place
vocabulary.example: Always put things away after you use them.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a service that removes animals like mice from buildings
vocabulary.example: Could you call pest control, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: full of interesting or important events
vocabulary.example: It's been an eventful day in the office.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to feel pain
vocabulary.example: My arm really hurts.

fine_lines.title: injury vs damage
fine_lines.explanation_ar: injury تُستخدم للأذى الذي يصيب الإنسان أو الحيوان، أما damage فتُستخدم للضرر الذي يصيب الأشياء.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Injury is harm to a person or animal. Damage is harm to things.

examples.sentence: He had a small injury to his arm.
The fire caused damage to the building.

fine_lines.title: sprain vs break
fine_lines.explanation_ar: sprain التواء في المفصل (مثل الكاحل أو الرسغ) وهو أخف. break كسر في العظم وهو أشد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A sprain is a twisted joint and is less serious. A break means the bone is broken.

examples.sentence: She sprained her ankle on the stairs.
He broke his leg playing football.

expressions.meaning_en: A question on an accident report form.
expressions.example: How did the accident happen? Please describe it.

expressions.phrase: What was the cause of the accident?
expressions.example: What was the cause of the accident? A wet floor.
Were there any injuries? Yes, one person hurt his hand.

expressions.phrase: How could the accident have been avoided?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking how to stop it happening again.
expressions.example: How could the accident have been avoided? By keeping the floor dry.
Call a first-aider – Tom's had an accident.

expressions.phrase: It's procedure and it's the law.
expressions.meaning_ar: إنه إجراء رسمي وهو أيضًا القانون.
expressions.meaning_en: Explaining why something must be done.
expressions.example: We have to report it. It's procedure and it's the law.

expressions.phrase: Do you need a hand with this form?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تحتاج إلى مساعدة في هذه الاستمارة؟
expressions.example: Do you need a hand with this form?

grammar.title: Past questions with did and was/were
grammar.explanation_ar: لنسأل عن حدث في الماضي نستخدم did + الفعل في المصدر (How did it happen?)، ومع الصفات والأسماء نستخدم was/were (What was the cause? Were there any injuries?).
grammar.explanation_en: To ask about the past use did + base verb (How did it happen?), and was/were with nouns and adjectives (What was the cause? Were there any injuries?).
examples: What was the cause of the accident?

grammar.title: could have been + past participle
grammar.explanation_ar: could have been + التصريف الثالث (مبني للمجهول) يتحدث عن شيء كان ممكنًا في الماضي لكنه لم يحدث: How could the accident have been avoided? أي: كيف كان يمكن تجنبه؟
grammar.explanation_en: could have been + past participle talks about something that was possible in the past but did not happen: How could the accident have been avoided?
examples: How could the accident have been avoided?
The accident could have been avoided.
The box could have been stored in the cupboard.

questions.question: Which question asks why the accident happened?
choices: What was the cause of the accident?

questions.question: Complete: 'How ___ the accident happen?'
questions.explanation_ar: سؤال في الماضي مع فعل عادي: did + المصدر.
questions.explanation_en: Past question with a main verb: did + base verb.

questions.question: Complete: 'How could the accident have been ___?'
What does 'trip over' mean?
choices: hit your foot on something and fall
questions.explanation_en: Trip over means hit your foot and fall.

questions.question: A person at work trained to give basic medical help is a ___.
questions.explanation_en: A first-aider gives basic medical help.

questions.question: Tom didn't break his arm. He ___ it.
questions.explanation_ar: sprain تعني التواء وهو أخف من الكسر.
questions.explanation_en: A sprain is less serious than a break.

questions.question: Where did Anna find the accident report form?
questions.explanation_ar: وجدت الاستمارة على الشبكة الداخلية للشركة.
questions.explanation_en: She found it on the company intranet.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: 'The fire caused a lot of ___ to the building.'
questions.explanation_en: Damage is for things; injury is for people.

questions.question: How could Tom's accident have been avoided?
choices: by storing things away and keeping the office tidy
questions.explanation_ar: قالت دنيس: خزّنوا الأشياء بشكل صحيح وحافظوا على ترتيب المكتب.
questions.explanation_en: Denise says: store things away properly and keep the office tidy.
